audit.why: Even lane at 55.12% over 1415 games. Early belongs to LeBlanc (Mel is immobile, one root), late flips to Mel via global Golden Eclipse. Level chart LeBlanc x6 then Mel matches both the packet and the prose.
audit.corrected: Left chart untouched — full and content layers already agree.

audit.why: LeBlanc spikes at 2 (Q-W double proc), 3 (chain), 6 (Mimic), first item. Mel's spikes are Rebuttal rank-ups (38s down to 26s) and Golden Eclipse ranks, which raise Overwhelm damage — so her ult ranks are damage spikes, not just utility.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text rewritten to state the global Overwhelm strike instead of a vague 'beam ult'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly calls Golden Eclipse a 'shield reflect'. Golden Eclipse is Mel's R (120/100/80s, global Overwhelm strike). The reflecting barrier is Rebuttal (W), 38/35/33/29/26s, 250 range. spikes[0] also claimed Mel has 'no hard CC' when Solar Snare (E) roots on 11/10.5/10/9.5/9.
audit.why: LeBlanc's Q (Sigil of Malice) and E (Ethereal Chains) are both projectiles per the kit, so both are the spells Rebuttal reflects; Distortion is a dash and is not. That is the decisive interaction and it was attributed to the wrong ability everywhere.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal named as the barrier throughout; Solar Snare named as her root with its cooldown; Golden Eclipse restated as the global Overwhelm strike, plus the Searing Brilliance execute threshold from missingInteractions.

audit.why: Rebuttal's 38s-to-26s range is the single number that decides when LeBlanc may step forward.

audit.whatIsWrong: Searing Brilliance's Overwhelm execute was never mentioned.
audit.why: Overwhelm stacks infinitely from any Mel damage and is consumed as an execute, so LeBlanc's usual 'I survived on a sliver' pattern is unsafe here.

edits.before: Mel has decent poke through Radiant Volley but no dash, blink, or hard CC to stop you from walking her down once your clone baits a reaction. Her shield ability, Golden Eclipse, punishes committed all-ins if you burst into it blind, so bait it out with the wraith clone before going in with your real body. Outside of that one interaction she's a stationary mage with no way to escape a determined engage, and you should be winning most short trades from level 3 onward.
edits.after: Mel pokes with Radiant Volley on a 10-second cooldown and has no dash or blink to escape you, but Solar Snare (E) roots at 1000 range every 11 seconds and is the shot you must dodge. Her barrier is Rebuttal (W), not her ultimate: it blanks her damage taken and reflects your Ethereal Chains and sigil straight back, so force it with the Mirror Image before your real body commits. Between Rebuttal windows she cannot leave, and you win short trades from level 3 onward.

edits.before: By level 6 your full combo (W-Q-Sigil-R) still kills her cleanly as long as you don't dump it into a raised Golden Eclipse — the shield reflects a portion of burst back at you, so always force it out with a fake engage first. She has no true reset or blink to escape once you commit for real, and her damage output, while solid at range, can't out-trade your burst speed in a straight 1v1. Keep roaming and pressuring; her lack of mobility means she can't punish your rotations around the map.
edits.after: By level 6 your full combo (W-Q-Sigil-R) kills her cleanly as long as you don't dump it into a raised Rebuttal — the barrier blanks the damage and throws your projectiles back, so force it with a fake engage first and commit inside its 26-second downtime. She has no dash or blink to leave once the chain lands, and her ranged damage can't out-trade your burst in a straight 1v1. Keep roaming and pressuring; with no mobility she cannot punish your rotations.

edits.before: Late game Mel becomes a genuine threat: her ultimate is a long-range beam with real teamfight and pick potential, and her shield reflect punishes messy engages from squishy assassins like you. This is the one phase where the numbers flip toward her — she can zone and threaten from range in ways your early-game dominance doesn't carry into. Close out the game before this scaling kicks in fully, and if you must fight her late, force Golden Eclipse down first every time.
edits.after: Late game Mel becomes a genuine threat: Golden Eclipse is global and strikes everyone carrying Overwhelm stacks, scaling with the chip damage she has already put on you, and Rebuttal punishes messy engages from squishy assassins like you. This is the one phase where the numbers flip toward her. Close the game before it arrives, and if you must fight her late, bait Rebuttal down first every time and keep your health clear of the execute threshold.
